reason: The token contract graph is now an ordinary runtime graph with no compiler, Node, vanilla-extract or Effect sources, and workspace plus packed Storybook maps pass the strict contract.

The repaired Storybook Crumbs graph is 117,301 source-content bytes, down from the prior 122,242-byte graph because native-style and native-capture are no longer reachable; source-map module bytes are diagnostic rather than native performance measurements.
No exact pre-adoption Metro/Hermes application-byte baseline is retained, and the retained package-level runtime-emitted-bytes threshold remains the deterministic +295.9% failure.
The Storybook packed install uses current range-resolved packages and legacy peer resolution, so its absolute bundle difference from workspace is not a Crumbs regression attribution.

limits: Export success is JavaScript bundle and source-map evidence; it is not physical iOS or Android acceptance.
Android exports were inspected only as JavaScript/source-map artifacts. Android device qualification remains parked.
The ordinary tokens entrypoint is runtime-safe; tokens/schema and tokens/optic remain explicit Effect boundaries and were not pulled into this graph.
The package still ships compiler dependencies for build-time entrypoints; isolating the token graph does not remove those installed dependencies.
The performance registry remains fail-closed until an exact application baseline and the outstanding device/editor/retained-memory gates are admitted.
